rows.title: What If You Could Rewatch Any Moment of Your Life? #Shorts
rows.description:
You finally get a remote that can replay your life… and the first memory you check isn't the one you remember at all. 📼
Your brain doesn't record videos: every time you recall a memory, it rebuilds it and stores it again, slightly changed ("reconsolidation"). And a story you tell often can end up replacing the original, even for the people who hear it.
Sources:
- Nader, Schafe & LeDoux (2000), Nature: a recalled memory becomes unstable and has to be stored again: https://doi.org/10.1038/35021052
- Neisser & Harsch (1992): two and a half years after the Challenger explosion, about 1 student in 4 told a completely different story from the one they wrote down the next day, and felt sure of it.
- Roediger, Meade & Bergman (2001): social contagion of memory (we "remember" what others told us): https://link.springer.com/article/10.3758/BF03196174
- Elizabeth Loftus: false memories planted through stories from relatives.
Fictional story based on these studies.
#Shorts #WhatIf #Memory

Ranking MCU foreshadowing moments you probably MISSED, part three.
At fifteen, Ant-Man and the Wasp has Janet warn Scott about TIME VORTEXES in the Quantum Realm, one movie before the Avengers discover they can use it to travel through time
At fourteen, the original Iron Man introduces the ten rings terrorist organization that kidnaps Tony Stark, thirteen years before Shang-Chi finally reveals their mysterious leader, Wenwu.
At thirteen, The First Avenger shows Red Skull getting sucked into the Tesseract's energy, secretly setting up his return as the soul stone's guardian in Infinity War.
At twelve, the original Ant-Man briefly shows a mysterious silhouette in the Quantum Realm, revealing Janet van Dyne was still alive, three years before she's rescued in the sequel.
But at number eleven, The Incredible Hulk shows Samuel Sterns getting infected with Bruce Banner's blood, causing his head to mutate, seventeen years before he finally returns as the Leader in Brave New World
